notes.title: Content Complete!
notes.content:
Hi,

We're bringing here the last update in a while... because we're content complete!

So, it's been quite a long journey but we've finally introduced all the levels and all the vehicles we wanted to have in the game. Career Mode has been changed to include all the new levels too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/db6c9e2e470b87bb74874aba957ffcccedf66dc7.png[/img]

We've also been doing some bugfixing and some tweaking (some new FX, audio balancing, etc.). And we're going to go on doing that. We know there are some things that should be better balanced and we're planning on spending some time on those. 

We also have plans to add a little bit more of content at some point, if we get some time. But we can't guarantee whether that will happen or when it happens (if it does).

We're going to increase the price and we've plans to take the game out of Early Access once we have the game a bit more balanced. We want to say a big THANK YOU to everyone that has contributed to the game with their ideas and criticism and have endured the previous unfinished versions of the game. I hope you guys find the final result is worth it.

Cheers,
Eduardo
Eclipse Games

notes.title: Major Technology Update
notes.content:
Hi,

We're back with a major technology change. As opposed to previous updates where there was lot of new content, in this one we're changing technology to improve performance significantly.

We think performance is really important in a racing game and anything we can do to improve that is going to affect significantly the responsiveness of the game. We tried a new rendering model in Unity (the game engine we're using) and we believe that fps (frames per second) have been increased by a range between 30% and 150%. It depends a lot on the computer and the graphics card you have, but in most tests we've done performance was improved in the range 60%-100%. We were pleasantly surprised and have worked hard to get the game to look as similar as it used to look as possible.

Besides that, we've tried to do a bit of bugfixing and we've finished localizing the game to all languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/dc8e5f700fd1859bea711b3de65f0fe8bcd9785a.jpg[/img]

Soon we'll post the last major update we're planning on doing: adding the last 3 tracks of the game. The image above is a sneak peek of one of the tracks we're currently working on.

As usual, please feel free to let us know your opinion on the game, this update or anything you feel like commenting in the forums or by any other means you deem fit.

Best regards,
Eduardo
Eclipse Games

notes.title: New Environment Update!
notes.content:
Hi,

We're back with a new update again! It's one of the last updates before the game leaves Early Access. This update introduces a new environment with 2 new tracks, 1 more track in the American diner environment, we've changed the handling to make it more accessible and responsive, while keeping the core of it similar to what it is now and we've done quite a bit of bugfixing (although there definitely may be more left to fix).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/9b016f8630f35baee53e921c6af37f6124ea8d18.jpg[/img]

So, the main new stuff you'll find in the update:
[list]
[*] [b]New Environment[/b] with 2 new tracks. The new environment is like a recording studio or a rehearsal studio with lots of instruments and music-related gadgets. The road also glows with the music, giving it a nice 'vibe' ;)
[*] [b]New Track in Diner[/b]. We've added a new extra track in the American diner environment. 
[*] [b]Tweaked Handling[/b]. We're trying to adjust the handling to the feedback. We're particularly worried that some people were unable to navigate the tracks without drifting and that made the game a lot less appealing to them. With the new update it should be easy to negotiate the tracks without drifting but if you drift you should have an advantage over those who don't, which is something we're definitely looking for. Easy to learn, hard to master.
[*] [b]Bugfixing[/b]. We've continued to do some bugfixing. This is an ongoing process, and we'll be focusing exclusively on this once we're done with all the content but still, we fix everything we see and can be done without too much hassle.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/d0c5d0a3181f52a2586ff7dd8343c9f7e98e5f64.jpg[/img]

As usual, we're really keen to listen from you. What do you think of the new tracks? Do you like the new handling? Is there anything we should do to improve the handling (or the game for that matter)? Comment on this or anything else in the forums. We do our best to answer every post personally ASAP.

Happy racing!
Eclipse Games

notes.title: Career Mode Update!
notes.content:
Hi,

It's been quite a while since last update but we haven't been idle. We were working hard on getting Career Mode ready and we're now happy with the current state of that game mode and have finally decided to release it officially! But this update not only has the new Career Mode, it has a lot of other new stuff. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/87d5e1acc31f303108a152f3c931cd57d68678da.jpg[/img]

Here you have a list of the most important ones:
[list]
[*] [b]Career Mode:[/b] A whole new single player game mode where you have to play through a bunch of cups to unlock new cups, vehicles and paintjobs. When you unlock new vehicles they become available for purchase and once you buy them you still have to upgrade them to make the most of them. Most cups have also vehicle restrictions meaning you can only access them with certain type of vehicles. In single player all vehicles are always available, but only the paintjobs you have unlocked in career mode are selectable.
[*] [b]New Paintjobs:[/b] We've included over 200 new color variations and completely new liveries for the cars in the game. They are very varied, from police car liveries, to camouflage, to post-apocalyptic costumes, etc. Every car has, at least, one completely new livery with most having 2, and a bunch of color variations that you have to unlock in career mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/5abcedec24410567f3bbf4fba9c1c1abd2e59efd.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]2 New levels:[/b] We've added 2 new tracks, one placed in the nursery environment but with new interactive objects (moving toy trains, spinning tops) and the other one in the American Diner in a part we hadn't visited in the first tracks.
[*] [b]Some handling improvements:[/b] We've been working on the collisions and the handling of the vehicle. We've tried to make the vehicle easier to handle, more predictable and also we've done our best to make collisions against walls as little punishing as possible. We've also done some minor work on the camera trying to avoid it spinning wildly when crashing. This work is still in progress.
[*] [b]Other minor optimizations and bugfixes:[/b] The menus have been improved in visual quality trying to get them to look more crispy and detailed while also trying to improve performance. Some other minor bugfixes have been addressed too.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/e1d36806f4c1d0fa8fd3638d79888d9898faad78.jpg[/img]
As usual we're really keen to listen from you. What do you think of the new Career Mode? Do you like the new liveries? And the new levels? Is the new handling an improvement over what we had? What do you think of the progress of the game? Comment on this or anything else in the forums. We do our best to answer every post personally ASAP.

Happy racing!
Eclipse Games

notes.title: Second Update!
notes.content:
Hi,

This is going to be a small update since we're still working hard on the career mode. We've basically added 4 new cars, all of them from a new vehicle class: open wheelers. These are cars that you can find in track events but you hardly see every day on the street!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/2769c859c8bad71519aa6a57890f6ce475d4969a.jpg[/img]

We've also done some minor visual improvements and fixes. We've added little else because we're working really hard on getting the Career Mode ready, at least, for preview as soon as possible. Who knows, maybe a new track too :)

As usual, please, share your thoughts on the new (or the old) cars in the forums or contact us directly (through mail or whatever other way you see fit) and give us your opinion. We honestly value your opinion highly and we'll do our best to fix everything that's broken in the game.

Best regards,
Eduardo

notes.title: First update!
notes.content:
Hi,

We've done our first update to the game! We're aiming to do an update every 2 weeks at least for the first 2 months, and we'll see from there on since we hope to have a lot more features in the game by then.

In this first update we have a few major inclusions:
[list]
[*]4 new cars: the Gran Turismo cars are now available to play with. 
[*]2 new game modes: we've added both Destruction and Death Race.
[*]Restart race button. It was something quite a few people asked for and we thought it was an oversight on our part so we fixed it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/1e21a490b7664af9a90a3c9a6ef7d949cd88a69f.jpg[/img]
The 2 new game modes are:
[list]
[*]Death Race is a normal race but if you're car is wrecked you stop playing there. Cars are considerably tougher in this game mode, and it gives harder cars an opportunity to beat fast cars by wrecking them.
[*]Destruction is a game mode where the target is to destroy as many of the dummy cars as possible before time runs out. Dummy cars are particularly nimble and wrecking one grants you some nice extra seconds.
[/list]
There are some minor tweaks to the handling and the levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35759907/8d55fe0e3d588173ea7f9cb899d5f9f4fa1b7481.jpg[/img]
Please, feel free to give us your feedback on the new cars or on anything else at any time in the forums.

Hope you like the update and happy racing!
Eduardo

P.S. We're working on the Career Mode. We're expecting to have a preview of the career mode by the time the next update goes live and have a first version ready for the following update.
